name: BlackHatWorld

sources.title: BHW Support — selling requires Jr VIP ($147/yr, needs 60 days + 100 posts) or Marketplace Seller ($749/yr, instant); threads cost $30 each after moderator approval
BHW Support (search-indexed) — signatures require a paid membership; marketplace threads renew at $30/yr

requirements: No free promotion route: signatures are a paid-membership feature (Premium $97/yr minimum) and marketplace sales threads require Jr VIP or Marketplace Seller
Jr VIP path: 60 days of membership + 100 posts + $147/yr; Marketplace Seller path: $749/yr with no waiting requirements
Every marketplace thread is reviewed by a moderator before going live and costs $30 per thread ($30/yr to keep it live)
Account must be free of active warnings during thread review
Sales threads must include pricing, contact details, refund policy, CTA and turnaround time
preparation: Decide the route: organic free participation only (no links), or paid seller path
For selling: budget $749/yr Marketplace Seller (immediate) or $147/yr Jr VIP after building 100 posts over 60+ days, plus $30 per sales thread
Sales thread copy with pricing, refund policy, contact details, turnaround time
workflow: Register a free account at blackhatworld.com (site 403s automated fetches — use a browser)
Free accounts can participate in discussion forums only — no signature, no marketplace
To sell: upgrade at /account/upgrades to Jr VIP (requires 60 days + 100 posts) or Marketplace Seller ($749 immediate)
Draft the marketplace thread in the appropriate section; a moderator reviews it
On approval, pay the $30 listing fee to publish; renew annually to keep it live
watchFor: The batch's 'free + register' framing is wrong for promotion — every promotional route on BHW is paid
Forum is an SEO/marketing community — a SaaS launch post outside the marketplace reads as spam and can earn warnings that block marketplace eligibility
Marketplace Seller is $749/yr — a serious spend for what is a forum sales thread
Warnings must be expired before thread review — keep the account clean
countsAsLive: An approved marketplace sales thread is publicly visible in a BHW Marketplace section, or (for the minimal case) a paid signature link renders under the member's posts
unknowns: Whether profile pages are publicly indexable
Link treatment (dofollow/nofollow) on signatures and marketplace threads
Moderator approval rate/turnaround for sales threads
